message.content: The culprit is `leggauss(3000)` being recomputed inside `kn_hist` for every photon bin. I'll compute the nodes once and cache the heavy matrices to disk.
message.reasoning:
The run timed out at 600 seconds with no output, so something in there is very slow - my prints only flush at the end so nothing showed up before the timeout. I suspect the nested loop calling moller_dsde on small arrays repeatedly, since 72900 iterations at even 100 microseconds each would add up to several seconds; I should add flushed print statements to isolate exactly which segment is the bottleneck.

Actually I think I found it - leggauss(3000) is being recomputed fresh on every call inside the energy-bin loop, roughly 279 times, and since leggauss scales quadratically each call could take a second or two, easily accounting for the full 500+ seconds. The fix is to compute leggauss once outside the loop and reuse it.

The run timed out at 600 seconds with no output, so something in there is very slow - my prints only flush at the end so nothing showed up before the timeout. I suspect the nested loop calling moller_dsde on small arrays repeatedly, since 72900 iterations at even 100 microseconds each would add up to several seconds; I should add flushed print statements to isolate exactly which segment is the bottleneck.

Actually I think I found it - leggauss(3000) is being recomputed fresh on every call inside the energy-bin loop, roughly 279 times, and since leggauss scales quadratically each call could take a second or two, easily accounting for the full 500+ seconds. The fix is to compute leggauss once outside the loop and reuse it.
